description: This file defines the AOW_Action class, part of the SuiteCRM project, representing action entities within the workflow system. It includes properties mapping to database fields, a constructor, and a method to save lines of action data based on user input.

classes.name: AOW_Action
classes.description: Represents an action within the SuiteCRM workflow module, with properties for its fields and methods for managing related line items.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Saves multiple action line entries from user input, handling creation, updating, and deletion based on posted data.
